data.short_meaning: God Shiva, Lord of Destruction and Transformation
data.long_meaning: Shivkumar is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Shiva, the destroyer of evil and creator of the universe, and Kumar, meaning young or prince. This name carries the power and strength of Lord Shiva, making it an ideal choice for a child who is destined for greatness and transformation.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shivkumar is derived from Hinduism, a rich and ancient culture that influences millions of people around the world. Shivkumar honors the deity Lord Shiva, who represents the ultimate reality, extinguisher of evil, and the giver of boons to his devotees. This name is not just a title, but a bond between the person holding it and the supreme power of Lord Shiva.
data.spiritual_significance: Shivkumar is a powerful spiritual name that signifies the divine blessings of Lord Shiva. It invokes a sense of grace, reverence, and strength, enabling the bearer to remain grounded and centered in both spiritual and practical matters. This name is believed to remind the person of their spiritual connection to the universe and innate potential for greatness. Furthermore, it carries the blessings of Lord Shiva, which includes wisdom, strength, and protection during challenging times.

historical_references.reference: Shivkumar was a title given to Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and regeneration. This title suggests a union of Shiva and Vishnu, whose names suggest 'universal consciousness' and 'preserver', respectively. This union signifies the cyclical nature of the universe: destruction leads to preservation, and preservation leads to destruction.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient India, circa 2nd millennium BCE - present day

historical_references.reference: Shivkumar is also the name of a famous Maratha king, Shivaji Bhonsle, who ruled the Maratha Empire from 1630 to 1680. This title was given to him as a mark of respect, reflecting his devotion to Shiva and his role as a powerful and just ruler.

seo.description_paragraph: Shivkumar is a unique and revered Hindu name that holds deep cultural and religious significance. Derived from the Sanskrit language, Shivkumar is a compound name that consists of two parts – Shiva and Kumar. Shiva is the name of the Hindu god, while Kumar refers to the young form of the god. This name is widely used in India and holds immense importance in Hinduism. It is believed that the name Shivkumar is bestowed upon children as a blessing from the deity Shiva.
